note: Context-vs-adaptation decomposition (A/B/C/D). The coder normally starts every chunk from a bare BOS, so information crosses a chunk boundary ONLY through the adapted weights; ctx_tokens prepends the last N already-coded tokens instead (rebuilt identically by the decoder, zero transmitted bits, folded into the archive hash). mode=both gives two cells per run, so ctx_tokens [0, 2048] x data covers the whole square: A=static/ctx0, B=online/ctx0, C=static/ctxN, D=online/ctxN. Reads: C vs A = what plain context is worth; D vs C = what adaptation still adds once context exists; overlap = (B+C)-D tells whether the two capture the same information. Fixed r32/alpha64/ep3/ti1/lr1e-4, compress-only. Cost note: context doubles the coded sequence (2048 ctx + 2048 data) so attention gets dearer; do NOT cache KV across a weight update (stale after every boundary) - just recompute. ctx_tokens cannot be combined with the g_k / branch / adjacency probes (measure_interval_bits still mirrors the BOS path). Analyse with evaluation/context_curve.py. lora_r fixed -> alpha=2*r.
